backlog.story: As a new patient, I want to register on the app, so that I can access medical services online.
As a patient, I want to search doctors by specialization/location, so that I can find a suitable doctor.
As a patient, I want to view a doctor's profile and available slots, so that I can pick a convenient time.
As a patient, I want to book an appointment, so that I can consult the doctor for my health issue.
As a patient, I want to pay online for the consultation, so that I can complete my booking.
As a patient, I want a video consultation with the doctor, so that I can get medical advice remotely.
As a patient, I want to view/download my e-prescription after consultation, so that I can buy the prescribed medicines.
As a patient, I want appointment reminders, so that I don't miss my consultation.
As a patient, I want to reschedule or cancel an appointment, so that I can manage schedule changes.
As a patient, I want to view my medical history, so that I can track past visits and prescriptions.
As an admin, I want automated deployment of HealthConnect updates, so that new features reach patients quickly and safely.
